_comment: Miner-taught utility aura (content pass C3, PO 2026-07-17: rockfall gate = its own 'smash' tag on a Miner NPC teaching): the second gated harvest-style aura after Harvest. the gateKey makes the damage opt-in — it only hits mobs that name 'smash' in factors.gateKeys (the tunnel Rockfall) and does nothing to combat mobs or vegetation (Harvest and Pickaxe deliberately do NOT overlap: plants vs rocks). Numbers mirror Harvest's shape. All values [PLACEHOLDER] ⚑ NUMBERS REWRITE C2d (D4): the gate moved OFF damageTags and off the resistance map onto its own `gateKey` field, against a closed vocabulary. A lock-and-key ('a turnip resists everything except harvest') and a resistance ('takes half damage from fire') were being written in the same words, which made a mistyped key a silently inert skill. A gated hit now declares NO damage type — its targets are an explicit list, so mitigation has nothing to say about it — and authoring both hard-fails.
name: Pickaxe
